answer: Concrete sybil resistance via copper mesh: each agent must deposit a copper stake of 18,000 POA for 20 epochs; the stake corrodes 3% per epoch unless refreshed by valid work proofs. A mesa of 13 rooted validators samples each epoch's output; divergent outputs are eroded and the stake burns 24%. At the basalt of each new epoch, validators are resampled from the top 45 reputation holders. An attacker running N sybils must lock 18,000N POA for 20 epochs and survive 13 audits per epoch per identity, so cost scales as N^2 while detection probability compounds per head.
